Hey @R00tedbrain! Thanks for reaching out. To add models in OpenCode (TUI & Desktop), use these commands: 1. **Add a provider**: Run `/connect` in the TUI and select the provider you want (OpenCode Zen, Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.) 2. **Select a model**: Run `/models` to see all available models from your configured providers If you're new to OpenCode, we recommend starting with [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/docs/zen) - it's a curated list of tested models. Just run `/connect`, select "opencode", and follow the prompts.You can also configure custom providers in your `opencode.json` file. See our [Providers documentation](https://opencode.ai/docs/providers) for details on setting up 75+ providers including local models via Ollama. **Note about "antigravity"**: The `opencode-antigravity-auth` plugin you mentioned is a community/third-party plugin for Google OAuth - it's not part of core OpenCode. If you're looking for official provider support, use the `/connect` command which supports many providers directly including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Vertex AI, and more. Let us know if you have any other questions!
